comment: OPUS_SET_BITRATE(8000) then OPUS_GET_BITRATE()==8000 via J#10684, over the 110-packet synth_mic stream.
At 8 kbps the shipped encoder switches to its low-rate layout: every packet carries the TOC low_rate bit (0x54/0x14/0x16),
two 160-sample subframes per 20 ms internal frame. All 220 packet/PCM hashes are asserted.
